digest.component_or_area: Plan-review acceptance criteria tagging and verification
propositions: The canonical acceptance-criteria tag should be renamed from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] to clarify that the evidence location (outside codebase) is the salient axis, not the attestor identity
[operator-attested] must remain as an undocumented compatibility alias for 827 existing immutable event-sourced tickets without breaking their close path or rendering
The tag matcher regex must accept both spellings case-insensitively using non-capturing alternation, and all existing tests feeding [operator-attested] must pass unchanged
Author-facing guidance and emitted classifications must be cut over to [non-codebase] only, while recognition-side prompts must instruct that both spellings are recognized
The completion-verdict kind wire value must be renamed from operator-attested to non-codebase with reader-widening sequenced before emitter changes to preserve legacy verdict rendering
The activation trigger in .rebar/criteria_routing.json and classification vocabulary in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json must be widened to accept both tag spellings
